verdict.rationale: Wise publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document, but only for the legacy Webhook Sender API. The docs state the main Wise Platform API reference has no public spec file, and probes of standard openapi.json and swagger.json paths all returned 404. missing for 10: a machine-readable spec for the main Wise Platform API (accounts, transfers, cards, balances), a spec at a discoverable standard path, and coverage beyond the legacy webhook surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Wise publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document ("## Download OpenAPI description") for its Webhook Sender API (the legacy webhook subscription surface).
